header.running_head: The Condition of the Sahabah (RA) when Rasulullaah ﷺ Passed away and Their Weeping at their Separation from Him

blocks.text: the Masjid burst out crying. Hadhrat Attaab (RA) left Makkah and went to one of the valleys of Makkah. Hadhrat Suhayl bin Amr (RA) approached him and told him to address the people. "I cannot speak after the demise of Rasulullaah ﷺ," replied Hadhrat Attaab (RA). Hadhrat Suhayl (RA) said, "Then come with me and I shall do it for you." They left and when they came to the Masjidul Haraam, Hadhrat Suhayl (RA) stood up to address the people. After duly praising Allaah, he delivered a lecture that was identical to the one that Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) gave the people (in Madinah). In fact, when Hadhrat Suhayl (RA) was a captive of the Battle of Badr, Rasulullaah ﷺ said to Hadhrat Umar (RA), "What makes you want to extract his front teeth? Leave him alone because Allaah shall perhaps place him on a platform that would bring you great pleasure." The platform Rasulullaah ﷺ referred to was this one by which the authority of Hadhrat Attaab (RA) was consolidated over Makkah and neighbouring areas.[^1]
Hadhrat Abu Ja'far says, "After the demise of Rasulullaah ﷺ, I never saw Faatima (RA) laugh. All I saw was her mouth extend on one side (as she smiled)."[^2]
What the Sahabah (RA) Said When Rasulullaah ﷺ Passed Away
The Statement of Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA): "Today we have Lost Revelation"
Hadhrat Is'haaq reports that when Rasulullaah ﷺ passed away, Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) said, "Today we have lost revelation and speech from Allaah."[^3]
The Statement of Hadhrat Ummu Ayman (RA) Concerning the Loss of Revelation

Hadhrat Anas (RA) reports that when Rasulullaah ﷺ passed away, Hadhrat Ummu Ayman (RA) wept bitterly. When asked what made her weep so bitterly about the demise of Rasulullaah ﷺ, she replied, "I always knew that Rasulullaah ﷺ would soon pass away, but what makes me weep is that revelation has now been lifted from us."[^4]

Hadhrat Anas (RA) also reports that after the demise of Rasulullaah ﷺ, Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) once said to Hadhrat Umar (RA), "Come with me to visit Ummu Ayman " When they came to her, she started weeping.
